insight.headline: Unlink a customer's identity provider subject with the GraphQL Admin API
insight.what_changed: As of API version 2027-01, you can use the identityProviderSubjectDelete mutation to unlink a customer from a third-party identity provider. Pass the customer's ID as customerId and the identity provider subject's ID as id. You can get subject IDs from Customer.identityProviderSubjects.
